feed.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: Re: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Over the past two years, significant progress has been made in the management and development of the BIPs (Bitcoin Improvement Proposals) repository. The team of six BIP Editors actively engaged with the community, leaving over four thousand comments, processing nearly six hundred pull requests—of which more than half were merged—and supporting the publication of forty-two BIPs. These efforts have contributed to a revitalized repository, marked by an uptick in submissions and more dynamic discussions among developers.
Key improvements included the introduction of a new BIP Process, updates to existing documents, resolution of issues related to abandoned submissions, and enhancements to the continuous integration scripts. While these changes have had a positive impact, there remains potential for further refinement and growth within the repository’s workflow.
Despite the collaborative nature of the editor team, much of the day-to-day work recently fell on one individual, underscoring the demanding nature of this role. The initial decision to expand the number of editors was based on the recognition that maintaining the BIPs repository is too great a responsibility for a single person. Appreciation is expressed for the dedication and insight provided by all contributors over the past two years.
To ensure continued progress and a sustainable workload, it is proposed that the BIP Editor team be refreshed, ideally comprising three editors who are consistently active and committed to maintaining the repository. This approach aims to foster ongoing collaboration and maintain the momentum achieved thus far.
